item.title: 🤝 Partnership forged by time Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika
item.description: Partnership forged by time 🤝 Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika took part in a solemn reception on the occasion of the 78th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. 👉 Deputy Head of the Russian military department emphasised that today Russian-Korean ties are going through one of the best periods in their entire history. The strategic partnership is based on the coincidence of fundamental national interests, common views on the international situation and world order, a high level of mutual trust, and the preservation of long-term good-neighbourliness for the benefit of the peoples of the two countries. 💬 Colonel General Vitaly Shulika, on behalf of the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation, expressed gratitude to the leadership of the DPRK and personally to the Chairman of State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Comrade Kim Jong Un , noting the special role of Korean servicemen in the liberation of the Kursk region from the Kiev regime's armed formations, in demining and restoring Russian infrastructure facilities. ‘I am convinced that the Russian-Korean partnership's strengthening meets the fundamental interests of our countries. It makes an invaluable contribution to ensuring stability not only in the region, but throughout the world,’ Colonel General Vitaly Shulika concluded. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Partnership forged by time
🤝
Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika
took part in a solemn reception on the occasion of the 78th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between the Russian Federation and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
👉
Deputy Head of the Russian military department emphasised that today Russian-Korean ties are going through one of the best periods in their entire history.
The strategic partnership is based on the coincidence of fundamental national interests, common views on the international situation and world order, a high level of mutual trust, and the preservation of long-term good-neighbourliness for the benefit of the peoples of the two countries.
💬
Colonel General Vitaly Shulika, on behalf of the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation,
expressed gratitude to the leadership of the DPRK and personally to the Chairman of State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Comrade Kim Jong Un
, noting the special role of Korean servicemen in the liberation of the Kursk region from the Kiev regime's armed formations, in demining and restoring Russian infrastructure facilities.
‘I am convinced that the Russian-Korean partnership's strengthening meets the fundamental interests of our countries. It makes an invaluable contribution to ensuring stability not only in the region, but throughout the world,’ Colonel General Vitaly Shulika concluded.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Trap for enemy birds Servicemen of the 30th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade (the Tsentr Group of Forces)
item.description: Trap for enemy birds ▫️ Servicemen of the 30th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade (the Tsentr Group of Forces) organised an echeloned system to counter enemy drones in Dobropolye direction. 💬 A sniper platoon commander with the call sign 'Gora' told about how the servicemen at the front line work as a single body. ‘Our main task it is to secure the sky, against small UAVs, such as FPV and kamikaze drones, and against large agricultural drones, such as Baba Yaga. We are always on guard, we always stay alert and keep doing our best to benefit our Motherland!’ said the serviceman. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 Competent operation near Petrovskoye: AFU servicemen escape positions, leaving their materiel
item.description: Competent operation near Petrovskoye: AFU servicemen escape positions, leaving their materiel 💬 Deputy platoon commander with the call sign ‘Osetiya’ gave details of the liberation of Petrovskoye (the DPR). ‘It was a competent operation planned by the command. We delivered FAB and UAV strikes, then we just entered and mopped up the settlement. It was small, so there were no troubles to get everyone out of there,' noted the serviceman. ▫️ ‘Osetiya’ demonstrated a trophy NATO weapon and equipment that was left at the enemy's positions ‘We looted NATO weapons already damaged by fragments. All stuff was left. As always, the enemy rode off into the sunset’. 📍 The liberation of Petrovskoye allowed the Group's units to establish control over the highway between Dobropolye and Kramatorsk. It cut off the AFU's supply routes, deprived them of safe routes to withdraw, and created conditions for a further offensive in Dobropolye direction. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ‘ The one, whose will is stronger, wins’ The marines of the 40th Separate Guards Brigade (the Vostok Group of Forces)
item.description: ‘ The one, whose will is stronger, wins’ 💬 The marines of the 40th Separate Guards Brigade (the Vostok Group of Forces) told about fighting to liberate the settlement of Nikolskoye (Zaporozhye region). ▫️ A serviceman with the call sign ‘Ten’ noted that in the battle everything was decided by the solid will of the fighters and competent support from the commanders: ‘The will has a very big influence. The one, whose will is stronger, wins the battle. The situations are different, but everyone wants to live, everyone is scared. That's why at this moment the commander's very first duty is to support his soldier, to show him, that the commander is close. We need to stay strong and go on’. 📊 During the battles, assault detachments established control over an area of about 13 square kilometres and mopped up more than 200 buildings. The following AFU elements were neutralised: ▪️ up to a company of manpower, ▪️ 15 armoured fighting vehicles, ▪️ 19 motor vehicles, ▪️ 29 ground robotic systems, ️️ ▪️ 48 heavy hexacopters. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 13 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉

)
🔥
The Tsentr Group's units inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one air assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two national guard brigades close to Liman, Verovka, Belozerskoye, Svyatogorovka, Veselaya Gora, Maryevka, and Novoyavlenka (Donetsk People's Republic).
📍
In Dobropolye
(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army advanced in the central and northern-western parts of the city. Marine units continued to mop up the controlled quarters of the city and the territory of the Dobropolskaya mine.
🚩
Over the past 24 hours, 286 buildings,
including three production facilities,
have been liberated,
up to 65 troops were neutralised.
▪️
In total, up to 345 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, and one Grad MLRS combat vehicle have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one air assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Gavrilovka, Tarasovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Dudnikovo, Zalivnoye, Blakitnoye, and Volnyanka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 240 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, eight motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov and Kushugum (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 40 troops, 20 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and two electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
the defence industry enterprises and transport infrastructure facilities of Ukraine used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, the production workshops of unmanned aerial vehicles and their depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 142 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
883 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total
, since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
260,703
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,

31,216
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,787
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,713
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️

special military vehicles.
